from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Captures a specific financial metric reported in one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report (e.g., '2023 年第一季度')")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric (e.g., '归属于母公司股东的综合收益总额')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
